blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Bamboo plantations that help the soil retain moisture, structures that keep topsoil from eroding, and water impounding systems that provide alternative supplies for farms are among the measures the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) is advancing to help upland communities cope with the effects of El Niño. During the October 5 Cabinet meeting on El Nino, the DENR reported its efforts to promote nature-based solutions that conserve soil moisture, protect agricultural lands, and sustain the natural resources on which farming communities depend. These initiatives complement President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr.’s directives to accelerate government preparations for […]...
